fields.title: Spotify podcast episode record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Spotify's podcast data, plus fields mined from each episode description. One EPISODE row per episode, one SHOW row per podcast, ERROR rows on failure. Spotify adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL or name that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: pathfinder-queryShowMetadataV2, pathfinder-queryPodcastEpisodes, pathfinder-getEpisodeOrChapter, pathfinder-searchSuggestions, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: not_found, unsupported_entity or fetch_failed.

episodeName.title: Episode title
episodeName.description: Episode title exactly as Spotify shows it.

description.title: Description
description.description: Full episode description with HTML stripped. This is where guests, chapter timestamps and sponsors are listed.

descriptionLength.title: Description length
descriptionLength.description: Characters in the description. A very short one usually means the publisher left it empty.

releasedAt.title: Released at
releasedAt.description: Full publication timestamp; Spotify publishes these to the minute.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Episode length as m:ss, or h:mm:ss for long episodes.

durationMinutes.title: Duration (minutes)
durationMinutes.description: Episode length rounded to whole minutes, for sorting and charting.

guestHints.title: Guest hints
guestHints.description: Names the title probably contains, derived by splitting on the separators podcast titles conventionally use. A heuristic, not a Spotify field - it can miss a guest or propose a segment name, which is why it is named hints.

episodeNumberHint.title: Episode number hint
episodeNumberHint.description: Episode number read out of the title when one is present. Also a heuristic.

chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.description: Timestamps found in the description, each with its display time, offset in seconds and label. Timestamps past the episode's own duration are discarded as false positives.

chapterCount.title: Chapter count
chapterCount.description: How many chapter timestamps were found.

links.title: Links
links.description: Every URL in the description, de-duplicated and stripped of trailing punctuation.

linkCount.title: Link count
linkCount.description: How many distinct URLs the description holds.

sponsorDomains.title: Sponsor domains
sponsorDomains.description: Domains from the description links after removing the show's own distribution and social platforms. In an ad-supported podcast these are usually the advertisers.

mentionedHandles.title: Mentioned handles
mentionedHandles.description: @handles named in the description, up to forty.

hasVideo.title: Has video
hasVideo.description: True when Spotify carries a video version of the episode.

mediaTypes.title: Media types
mediaTypes.description: AUDIO, VIDEO or both, as Spotify reports them.

hasTranscript.title: Has transcript
hasTranscript.description: True when Spotify lists a transcript for the episode. The transcript text itself is not public and is not fetched.

explicit.title: Explicit
explicit.description: True when Spotify labels the episode explicit.

playable.title: Playable
playable.description: Whether Spotify reports the episode as playable.

shareUrl.title: Share URL
shareUrl.description: Spotify's own share link, including its si tracking parameter.

audioPreviewUrl.title: Audio preview
audioPreviewUrl.description: Preview clip URL, when Spotify publishes one.

showName.title: Podcast
showName.description: Name of the show this episode belongs to.

showDescription.title: Show description
showDescription.description: SHOW rows: the podcast's own description, HTML stripped.

episodeCount.title: Episode count
episodeCount.description: SHOW rows: total episodes in the catalogue, which can far exceed the number scraped.

averageRating.title: Average rating
averageRating.description: SHOW rows: listener rating out of 5.

totalRatings.title: Total ratings
totalRatings.description: SHOW rows: how many listeners rated the show.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: SHOW rows: the categories Spotify files the podcast under.

mediaType.title: Show media type
mediaType.description: SHOW rows: AUDIO, VIDEO or MIXED across the catalogue.

consumptionOrder.title: Consumption order
consumptionOrder.description: SHOW rows: EPISODIC, SERIAL or RECENT - how the publisher intends the show to be listened to.
